stage: CUBE-REV 0.10.5-R1.5 — Immutable Submission Snapshot Promotion, Duplicate Stored-byte Reverification & Receipt-race Closure

research_design.reason: Factorized runner observations are retained as mechanism-oriented auxiliary evidence, but population and external-validity claims should rely primarily on established public cubing data.

source_tiers.source: World Cube Association Results Export v2
limitations: public-person fields require WCA terms-of-use compliance
strong selection bias toward notable/fast/reconstructed solves
not a population-frequency estimator without explicit sampling correction
bulk-use/API/terms must be checked before automated ingestion
software repositories are not themselves representative human solve corpora

planned_join_logic: Use WCA competition/event/round/person/result/attempt as the population frame.
Attach official scramble text through WCA scramble metadata where identifiers/round structure permit exact linkage.
Link reconstruction records only when solver, competition/date/result and scramble metadata jointly support the match; otherwise retain as unlinked move-level evidence.
Estimate selection into the reconstruction corpus before making any aggregate trajectory claim.
Use solver-generated routes only as counterfactual comparators, never as substitute human observations.
